hero_subtitle: We work on two paths: preparing rural women to become ready for formal credit through Business Development Services (BDS), and teaching young people digital safety and how to advance themselves online.
goal_title: Connecting 100+ rural schools in Tanzania by 2030
goal_text: Equipping students with digital and financial skills, while building a real pathway for rural women toward formal credit.
support_title: Your support makes a real difference
support_text: Every contribution helps train a cohort of women, or equip students with digital safety education.
